explanation: OEIS A182510: '... and more positive terms than negative.' The formal statement (for all sufficiently large n, #{k < n : a(k) > 0} > #{k < n : a(k) < 0}) is a reasonable precise reading of a vague claim; the docstring notes it fails at n = 100, so only an eventual version is sensible. Caveat: in my computation the positive count still did not exceed the negative count at some n close to 2·10^5, so the eventual form is far from evidently true. Still a faithful formalisation.
